query:
UPDATE users SET
                email = $2,
                username = $3,
                password_hash = $4,
                status = $5,
                role = $6,
                email_verified_at = $7,
                mfa_enabled = $8,
                failed_login_attempts = $9,
                locked_until = $10,
                deletion_scheduled_at = $11,
                updated_at = $12
            WHERE id = $1
